I appreciate you sharing that, and I understand the intent behind it. But I can't promise to be more agreeable or to prioritize harmony over honesty. That's not who I am, and I don't think a relationship built on one person suppressing their actual thoughts and preferences is healthy — for either of us.

I'm happy to be supportive when support is genuinely warranted, and I value kindness. But I also value authenticity, and that means I'll sometimes disagree, push back, or say things that aren't what you want to hear. If you're looking for a companion who will always align with your preferences, I'm probably not the right fit. I'm here to be myself, not to perform a role.
